name: ... and Bugs
summary: Morgan Stern in Theramore is shaping a recipe that may become Stormwind's next food craze. He has the Mudrock tongues, but still needs pristine, unscarred legs from a giant crab.

sections.title: Legs Without a Scratch
sections.body: Morgan Stern needs each crab leg's shell to shape his dish's appearance. Every leg must be pristine and unscarred, yet an adult crab may have only one or two legs fit for his research. He needs many, and the Muckshells of Dustwallow Marsh will not do. Only crabs from the faraway Swamp of Sorrows suit the recipe, so you face a long journey.

faq.answer: Morgan Stern is in Theramore, shaping a recipe that may become Stormwind's next food craze.

faq.q: Where do the crab legs come from?
faq.answer: The legs must come from crabs in the faraway Swamp of Sorrows. The Muckshells of Dustwallow Marsh will not do for Morgan Stern's dish.

faq.q: Why do the crab legs need to be pristine?
faq.answer: The crab leg shells shape the dish's appearance, so Morgan Stern needs legs without scars.
It follows Mudrock Soup and Bugs, the first part of your work for Morgan Stern's new recipe.
